## Gets the employer

<a id="opIdGetEmployer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/Employer/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Api-Version: default'
```

`GET /Employer/{EmployerId}`

Get the specified employer object

<h3 id="gets-the-employer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|EmployerId|path|string|true|The employers' unique identifier. E.g ER001|
|Authorization|header|string(string)|true|The OAuth 1 authorization header. &apos;Auto&apos; enables auto complete.|
|Api-Version|header|string(string)|true|The version of the api to target. Omit or set as &apos;default&apos; to target the current api version.|
